name: Chen Linong
bio: Chen Linong (traditional Chinese: 陳立農; simplified Chinese: 陈立农) is a Taiwanese singer and actor active in mainland China. He took part in the Chinese survival show Idol Producer and debuted as a member of Chinese boy group NINE PERCENT (百分九) as a vocalist. He released his first solo album Unbelonging (格格不入) on May 29, 2020.
